system.description:
Sometimes the answer isn't a spell thrown in anger — it's ten minutes of quiet and the right working turned towards a question instead of a target. Once per day, cast any divination-type spell you know as a ritual investigation over 10 minutes without expending a slot, usable outside combat. You also have Advantage on Intelligence checks to identify spells, magic items and magical effects.

Available to: Wizards, Clerics, Druids, Illusionists, Paladins, Magi, Bards, Sorcerers, Warlocks, Witches, Necromancers, and Artificers.

rules.when: to identify spells, magic items and magical effects
